paragraphs: IamResponding sells an end-to-end emergency response system for first responders. The system is described as covering dispatch communication, incident coordination and department management.

Responders get time-saving alerts and critical incident data. An integration from RapidSOS is advertised on the home page. The company says that when an emergency comes in, responders are equipped with data such as location, health profiles, vehicle telematics and alarm information. The back end is described as fully redundant, with zero system downtime for the past 8+ years. Pricing on the site is listed as starting from $349 per year.

The company says it started in 2006 as a simple internet-based solution for station communication issues. It claims decades of first-hand emergency services experience among its own people. A percentage of every new subscription goes to the National Fallen Firefighters Foundation. Testimonials on the site are attributed to fire chiefs. One comes from a director of emergency services. The company also cites a 2022 member survey.

quote.text: IamResponding is an end-to-end emergency response system for first responders everywhere.
